_comment: FEX compatibility profiles, loaded by fexrift.py and matched by fexrift_compat.py. No entitlement changes.

match: OR of canonical_names (exact Meta names), sha256 (list of exe hashes), executables (list of {name,size}, both required). Without match the key is the exact canonical name. Ambiguous matches are refused.

status: verified (headset checked), likely (static evidence; install with warning), untested (force_unverified required), blocked (refuse even force). graphics: d3d11|d3d9 (DXVK), d3d12 (vkd3d-proton), opengl (PROTON_USE_WINED3D), vulkan.

env: string-valued environment; args: optional launch arguments override (absent keeps manifest). dxvk: dxvk.conf lines written only to the launcher anchor. notes: evidence and first-launch checks. revive: false for direct OpenVR games, otherwise true.
ime_patch: optional fallback {rva,old,new}, RVA may be hex; generic finder always wins, including old modular Core.dll. Null means no fallback, never an exemption from IME checks.

fp_mem: off|candidate|enabled; candidate is informational and NEVER enables the unzeroed cache. enabled requires verified status. bigcache_mb: cache size when enabled, default 256. env FP_MEM is an explicit opt-in retained for First Contact.
exe is the verified First Contact fallback only; other profiles keep the Meta manifest launch path. msaa_ini allows --msaa for that verified game only.

oculus-first-contact.title: Oculus First Contact
oculus-first-contact._env: Unreal's large-block allocator gives 0.5-1.6 GB blocks back every few seconds and this game overwrites them completely: fp_mem keeps them (native/fexwine/fp_mem.c)
oculus-first-contact.notes: Headset verified; r.MobileMSAA=2 prevented rendering. Other games remain unverified.
